title: agropyron pectinatum
intro: Agropyron pectinatum, commonly known as slough grass, is a type of plant in the grass family (Poaceae). It is often used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Agropyron pectinatum include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
